builds.name: Hawk King
builds.desc: Massive attack is the name of the hawk king's game. 60atk once he transforms, 66 on initiation, and 72 on odd turns. His PRF affords him guaranteed follow ups on initiation and prevents foes from following up, promising his Draconic Aura will activate thanks to heavy blade (provided you're attacking someone with less than 60atk.) He was named King for a reason.

builds.name: Gale King
builds.desc: This built exists to capitalize on Tibarn's guaranteed follow-up and huge attack to proc heavy blade and galeforce. His A skill is required to make him bulkier on player phase, and able to more freely attack. His B skill is flexible, but I like Hit and Run so that he will back up closer to your repo/dance units after his second turn, or advance farther if he attackes a unit from behind. His C skill is purely to give him more attack. His seal is a requirement to allow him to proc galeforce in a single round of combat.

builds.name: The King of the Skies
builds.desc: All around build that allows tibarn to launch bonfires rapidly. Assist is flexible, but reposition is highly recommended just to help allies.
